{"id":"mimid-1wgh.44.22","title":"wg: draft-mahy-mls-semiprivatemessage-08 defects (external_receivers registry, §3.3 verification, naming)","description":"From assay mimid-1wgh.44.6 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mls-semiprivatemessage-08.txt. Posting needs Mark's OK (repo github.com/rohanmahy/mls-semiprivatemessage).

1. external_receivers: extension or component? §1 L123-124 and §3 L150 call it a 'GroupContext extension'; §5.2 L418 registers an 'MLS Component Type' but with the Extension Types template ('Message(s): GC', L427). Suggested 0x0007 is free as a component (Rohan's coordination gist lists component 0x0007 external_receivers) but collides as an extension type with mls-extensions-11 supported_wire_formats (0x0007 suggested, -11 txt L1620). The two choices differ in how the list changes (AppDataUpdate vs GroupContextExtensions; -11 §4.7).
2. §3.3 L382-385: the external receiver 'verifies that the framed_content_tbs_hash is correct' unconditionally but checks the signature only 'if [it] has a copy of the GroupContext'. FramedContentTBS includes the GroupContext for a member sender (RFC 9420 §6.1), so the hash cannot be checked without it either.
3. §3.3 L379 'Using the nonce and sender_leaf_node' should be sender_leaf_index (the field of PerMessageKeyAndNonces, L233); L381 'the member decrypts' in the external-receiver section should be 'the external receiver'.
4. §3.1 names: key_and_nonces (L244, L253) vs keys_and_nonces (L251) vs encrypted_key_and_nonces (L247) vs encrypted_keys_and_nonces (L257, L267).
5. §3.1 L236 partial_context_hash = hash(sender_leaf_index || nonce): the byte encoding of the concatenation (uint32 big-endian? nonce with or without its length?) is not stated.
6. L344 MLSMessage arm 'mls_semiprivate_message_' has a stray trailing underscore.
7. Reference is mls-extensions-10 (L453-458); -11 is current. §4 is TODO (L404).","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-11-16T00:18:06.760968814Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-11-16T00:18:06.760968814Z","labels":["wg","spec-assay"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"mimid-1wgh.44.22","depends_on_id":"mimid-1wgh.44","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-11-16T00:18:06.793380655Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
